3542-7546-8208.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
Inspired Skypainter is prepared.
3542-7546-8208.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Maestro's Gift by paying {3}{U}{R}, targeting Palinchron.
Codie triggers, copying Maestro's Gift, targeting Inspired Skypainter.
Resolve the copy of Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste
When the Inspired Skypainter token enters, it triggers, causing it to become prepared.
Resolve the original Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Palinchron with haste
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-6634.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3110-5078-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Council of the Absolute.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

2511-7084-7885.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-3680.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-3680.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Stunt Double and Hulking Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-3680.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2034-2279-3240-6462.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2469-5220-5708-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

2034-3808-5394.description:
Activate Halsin by paying {1}, causing an artifact token you control to become a 4/4 Bear in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bear, adding {C}{C}.
When the Bear dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token.
Repeat.
2034-3808-5394.notes: With the excess mana, you can instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2463-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

81-1978-5776.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat

851-2034-4017-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-2034-4017-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

1274-4659-5086-5183-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-4659-5086-5183-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-3499-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

955-3490-3755-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
955-3490-3755-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-5231-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-5231-6719.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1778-2173-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1117-3689-6518-6556.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-1887-2034-2122.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-1887-2034-2122.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1455-1645-3581.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting Kykar.
Vesuvan Duplimancy and each Kykar you control triggers.
Resolve each Kykar trigger, creating that many 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Vesuvan Duplimancy trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kykar.
Resolve Crown of Flames, attaching it to Kykar.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
If you control another Spirit token, activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you control three or more Kykars, you may target any other creature instead to get infinite nonlegendary copies of it.

914-2034-2588-4719.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2034-2588-4719.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist and Anarchist, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Agadeem's Awakening by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Anarchist and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Anarchist and Dockside Extortionist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Anarchist trigger, returning Agadeem's Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2655-4258.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from your command zone this game.
An additional instant or sorcery in hand with the mana to cast it, or an opponent has cast an as of yet unresolved instant or sorcery spell.
2655-4258.description:
Cast your additional instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a Pest creature token.
Cast Fury Storm targeting the instant or sorcery spell.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a Pest creature token.
Fury Storm triggers, copying itself for each time you have cast your commander from your command zone this game and choosing the original copy of Fury Storm as the target.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers for each copy, creating a Pest creature token each time.
Resolve a Fury Storm copy, copying Fury Storm and choosing the original Fury Storm as the target.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a Pest creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

1479-1671-3703.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-3703.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Sporemound, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Sporemound trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1671-2895-3293-4572.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Return Simic Growth Chamber to your hand using its enter the battlefield trigger.
Emeria Shepherd triggers, targeting Uro.
Uro returns from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Stack Uro triggers so Uro is sacrificed first, then draw a card and play Simic Growth Chamber.
Repeat steps 2-5.
